market.headline: Nvidia's results lifted the open, but talk from the Fed about a bigger rate hike and a 5.12% 10-year yield pushed SPY back down to its 200-day average at 730.02. Fear is high, with VIX at 25.46.
market.day_type: Faded rally and rotation inside tech. Nvidia's results pushed futures up, then hawkish Fed comments and Nvidia's leadership crisis moved money out of Nvidia and the neoclouds and into AMD, Amazon and Broadcom.
watch: SPY at 730.02 (200-day average) and 726.79 (today's low): a close below both confirms the downtrend, so cut risk.
QQQ at 646.64 (20-day low): if it breaks, tech selling starts again. If it holds, today's rotation into AMD and AVGO can continue.
Nov 24 Dell earnings (AI servers), then Nov 25 at 08:30 GDP and PCE inflation. That report decides whether the Fed's hike talk gets louder.

stocks.headline: Strong results still could not stop the slide: down 2.9% to 150.96 on 1.4x normal volume, and down 32.0% in 20 days. This morning's call was right.
stocks.why: The business is booming. The last filed quarter showed sales up 106%, an operating margin of 65% and forecasts up 23% in 90 days, and the company raised its outlook. The stock is falling for other reasons: the founder quit in a scandal, he now faces Senate and House hearings, and the interim CEO said Nvidia has stopped selling advanced AI chips to China. At 19x trailing profit, its lowest in 5 years, the price already reflects a lot of bad news, but no floor has formed yet. The knock-on effect is clear: neoclouds like CRWV sold off with it, and buyers moved to AMD and AVGO as the other AI chip suppliers.

long_term.reason: This agrees with the house view. The numbers and the valuation argue for buying, but the leadership and China damage is not finished, and the hearings can bring out more.

stocks.what_would_change_it: A close back above 156.14 while the market is steady makes it Add on dips. A close below 148.8 or damaging testimony makes it Trim.
stocks.action: Don't buy tomorrow. Buy a trading position only if it trades back above 156.14 after the first hour. If you own it, keep it unless it closes below 148.8.

levels.means: above = the market finally accepts the results, below = the scandal is still in control
above = the 52-week low is holding, below = new lows with no support
above = today's failed rally is reversed, below = sellers still cap every bounce

stocks.headline: Up 5.3% to 530.14 and closed near the day's high of 532.17. This morning's call (trade above 515.77) was right.
stocks.why: AMD is the obvious winner from Nvidia's China exit and leadership turmoil. Buyers treated it as the alternative AI chip supplier. The business backs this up: sales are up 45% and speeding up, the operating margin doubled from 9% to 18%, and forecasts are up 15% in 90 days, with 35 raised against 3 cut. The risks are price and swings. It trades at 108x trailing profit, above peers, and it moves about twice as much as the market, so a Fed scare hits it hard. Volume was only 0.9x normal, so big funds have not fully committed yet.

long_term.reason: This moves up from the house Wait because Nvidia's China halt and CEO crisis shift AI chip orders toward AMD, while AMD's own growth and margins are speeding up. The price is high, so buy only on pullbacks.

stocks.what_would_change_it: A close back below 514.64 means the rotation failed and it goes back to Wait.
stocks.action: Don't chase the open above 532.17. Add only on a dip that holds 514.64, the 20-day average.

above = the uptrend is intact and dips are buys, below = today's move failed
above = the 50-day average is reclaimed and the trend has turned, below = sellers wait here

stocks.headline: Up 3.8% to 267.74, near the day's high, as Anthropic's IPO shows Amazon will be its biggest outside owner.
stocks.why: The Anthropic stake is real hidden value, and today the market started to price it ahead of the IPO. The core business is weaker than the stock suggests. Profit per share fell 3% while sales grew 12%, growth is slowing, last quarter missed forecasts, and long-term debt is 180.9B. It is cheap at 21x trailing profit, lower than 97% of the last 5 years, but forecasts are flat. Volume was light at 0.8x normal. GOOGL owns almost as much of Anthropic and barely moved, so a strong IPO gives GOOGL a catch-up trade.

long_term.reason: This agrees with the house view. The Anthropic value is real, but falling profit, slowing sales and heavy debt mean today's pop is IPO excitement, not a better business.

stocks.what_would_change_it: A close above 275.34 on strong volume, or a strong Anthropic IPO, makes it Add on dips.
stocks.action: Don't buy the open. Buy only on a close above 275.34. If it falls back below 259.63, the Anthropic pop has failed, so stay out.

levels.means: above = a new 20-day high and the IPO story has legs, below = it is still in a range
above = today's gain holds, below = the pop is fully reversed
above = the short-term trend is up, below = the trend is lost
